subject: POC Kickoff & Hands-on Session: Scheduling and Pre-read
messages:
From: Emily Nguyen <emily.nguyen@atlaspayments.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ryan O'Connor <ryan.oconnor@atlaspayments.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: POC Kickoff: AtlasPayments x Redwood — scheduling

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed. We'd like to kick off a short POC to validate routing and load characteristics for one of our payment flows and run a hands-on session for prompt tuning and prompt routing.

High-level goals:
- Review initial prompt sets and expected outputs (prompt quality / safety checks)
- Exercise routing policies (primary model + low-cost fallback)
- Run basic load tests (target: 500 concurrent users simulated; peak token sizes ~1k)

Can we schedule a 90-minute kickoff + working session the week of May 25? Prefer afternoons PST. If you can share a draft agenda and any pre-reads we should review beforehand, that would be great.

Thanks,
Emily Nguyen
Head of Product
AtlasPayments

P.S. Ryan will join from infra — he can share their expected throughput later in-thread.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emily Nguyen <emily.nguyen@atlaspayments.com>, Ryan O'Connor <ryan.oconnor@atlaspayments.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC Kickoff: AtlasPayments x Redwood — scheduling

Hi Emily — great to hear. We'd love to run the hands-on session and validate routing + load. Proposed options (PST):
- Tue May 26, 2:00–3:30pm
- Thu May 28, 3:00–4:30pm

Please confirm which works for your team and I'll send a calendar invite.

Draft agenda (attached: POC_kickoff_agenda_v1.pdf):
1) 10m — Introductions & success criteria
2) 20m — Prompt review (examples + fail cases)
3) 25m — Routing & model variant discussion
4) 30m — Hands-on load test (small simulated runs)
5) 5m — Next steps & action items

Pre-read checklist (attached):
- Sample prompt set (5–10 examples)
- Expected qps/concurrency and typical token length
- Any security/access requirements for private endpoints

Ben (AE) and Dev (Solutions Eng) are looped in to help with logistics and load test config. Dev — can you confirm required artifacts from Atlas for the load run?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: POC_kickoff_agenda_v1.pdf (1 page — agenda draft)
Attachment: POC_pre-read_checklist.md (checklist & prep questions)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Emily Nguyen <emily.nguyen@atlaspayments.com>, Ryan O'Connor <ryan.oconnor@atlaspayments.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-21T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC Kickoff: AtlasPayments x Redwood — scheduling

Emily / Ryan — quick logistics note from our side. For the hands-on load test Dev will need:
- A short list of representative prompts (5–10) and an example distribution (percentile of each prompt)
- Expected concurrency and target sustained qps (you mentioned ~500 concurrent — can you confirm qps?)
- Average / max token lengths (you estimated ~1k tokens max)
- Any IP allowlist / firewall rules for our test endpoints (if you want to use private deployment)

I've attached a simple load_test_config.xlsx template you can fill out. If you'd rather we run a short smoke test during the session with synthetic traffic, we can do that first and then run a larger profile later.

On availability: we still have Thu May 28, 3:00–4:30pm open. If Tue the 26th is tight, Thu works for us.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: load_test_config.xlsx (Excel template — fields: prompt_id, proportion, avg_tokens, peak_tokens, expected_qps, note)

From: Emily Nguyen <emily.nguyen@atlaspayments.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-22T11:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC Kickoff: AtlasPayments x Redwood — scheduling

Thanks all — quick update: we have an exec review on Tue the 26th and need to move the session. Thu May 28, 3:00–4:30pm PST works for most of the team. Can you send the calendar invite for that slot?

Ryan will bring our infra/security contact (Sofia Martinez) to the follow-up security session; please add her email (sofia.martinez@atlaspayments.com) when we loop security.

We'll fill out the load_test_config.xlsx and send it back by EOD Wed.

Appreciate it — looking forward to the hands-on run.

Best,
Emily

All — confirmed. I've scheduled Thu May 28, 3:00–4:30pm PST and sent the calendar invite (link below). Final agenda and pre-reads are attached and shared to the Drive. Please review the pre-read before the session so we can spend most of the time running tests.

Final agenda (attached: POC_kickoff_final_agenda.pdf):
- 3:00–3:10pm — Introductions & success criteria (Marissa)
- 3:10–3:35pm — Prompt review + safety checks (Dev)
- 3:35–4:05pm — Routing & model variant exercise (Ben + Dev)
- 4:05–4:25pm — Hands-on load test (Dev running synthetic profile)
- 4:25–4:30pm — Next steps & action items

Pre-reads / artifacts (Drive):
- Slides: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bPOC-Atlas-Redwood
- Pre-read checklist: POC_pre-read_checklist.md (attached)
- Load test template: load_test_config.xlsx (once you send it back we'll schedule the larger run)

Prep questions (please answer in the doc or in reply):
1) Which flows should we prioritize during the hands-on run? (e.g., auth, refund, dispute)
2) Expected sustained qps and burst qps during peak windows
3) Any IP allowlist or private endpoint requirements
4) Key success metrics for the POC (latency SLO, cost per 1k tokens, error rate thresholds)

If anyone on your side needs a different time, let me know by EOD and we'll adjust. Otherwise see you May 28.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=POC-Atlas-Redwood-20260528
